meta_business_unit_id.description: The `ID` of the meta business unit the machine will be assigned to at enrollment.

osquery_release.description: Osquery release to include in the enrollment artifacts.

quota.description: The number of time the enrollment can be used.

serial_numbers.description: The serial numbers the enrollment is restricted to.

tag_ids.description: The `ID`s of the tags that the machine will get at enrollment.

udids.description: The `UDID`s the enrollment is restricted to.

block.description: The data source `zentral_osquery_enrollment` allows details of a Osquery enrollment to be retrieved by its `ID`.

access_monitoring.description: If `true`, FIM will include file access for this file category. Defaults to `false`.

description.description: Description of the Osquery file category.

exclude_paths.description: Set of paths to exclude from the Osquery file category.

file_paths.description: Set of paths to include in the Osquery file category.

file_paths_queries.description: Set of queries returning paths to monitor as path columns in the results.

name.description: Name of the Osquery file category.

block.description: The data source `zentral_osquery_file_category` allows details of a Osquery file category to be retrieved by its `ID` or name.

discovery_queries.description: List of osquery queries which control whether or not the pack will execute.

event_routing_key.description: Routing key added to the metadata of the events that the queries of this pack generate.

shard.description: Restrict the pack to a percentage (1-100) of target hosts.

block.description: The data source `zentral_osquery_pack` allows details of a Osquery pack to be retrieved by its `ID` or name.

compliance_check_enabled.description: If `true`, the query will be used as compliance check. Defaults to `false`.

minimum_osquery_version.description: Only run on Osquery versions greater than or equal-to this version string

platforms.description: Restrict the query to some platforms, default is 'all' platforms

can_be_denylisted.description: If `true`, this query can be denylisted when stopped by the watchdog for excessive resource consumption. Defaults to `true`.

interval.description: the query frequency, in seconds. It has a maximum value of 604,800 (1 week).

log_removed_actions.description: If `true`, remove actions should be logged. Default to `true`.

shard.description: Restrict this query to a percentage (1-100) of target hosts.

snapshot_mode.description: If `true`, differentials will not be stored and this query will not emulate an event stream. Defaults to `false`.

scheduling.description: Attributes to link a query to a pack for scheduling.

tag_id.description: `ID` of the machine tag that is updated by this query.

value.description: Description of the results returned by the query.

block.description: The data source `zentral_osquery_query` allows details of a Osquery query to be retrieved by its `ID` or name.

cel_transformation.description: CEL expression that is used to transform the event data. The input to the expression is a `Map` with two keys: `metadata` for the event metadata and `payload` for the event payload.

headers.description: A set of additional HTTP headers to add to the requests.

block.description: The data source `zentral_probe_action` allows details of a probe action to be retrieved by its `ID` or its `name`.

id.description: alias for the UUID of the realm.

block.description: The data source `zentral_realm` allows details of a realm to be retrieved by its `UUID` or its `name`.

allow_unknown_shard.description: Restrict the reporting of 'Allow Unknown' events to a percentage (0-100) of hosts.

allowed_path_regex.description: A regex to allow if the binary, certificate, or Team ID scopes did not allow/block execution.

batch_size.description: The number of rules to download or events to upload per request.

block_usb_mount.description: If set to `true` blocking USB Mass storage feature is enabled.

blocked_path_regex.description: A regex to block if the binary, certificate, or Team ID scopes did not allow/block an execution.

client_certificate_auth.description: If `true`, mTLS is required between Santa and Zentral.

client_mode.description: Client mode of the Santa configuration.

enable_all_event_upload_shard.description: Restrict the upload of all execution events to Zentral, including those that were explicitly allowed, to a percentage (0-100) of hosts

enable_bundles.description: If set to `true` the bundle scanning feature is enabled.

enable_transitive_rules.description: If set to `true` the transitive rule feature is enabled.

full_sync_interval.description: The max time to wait before performing a full sync with the server.

remount_usb_mode.description: Array of strings for arguments to pass to `mount -o`.

sync_incident_severity.description: If 100, 200, 300, incidents will be automatically opened and closed when the santa agent rules are out of sync.

block.description: The data source `zentral_santa_configuration` allows details of a Santa configuration to be retrieved by its `ID` or name.

meta_business_unit_id.description: The `ID` of the meta business unit the machine will be assigned to at enrollment.

tag_ids.description: The `ID`s of the tags that the machine will get at enrollment.

udids.description: The `UDID`s the enrollment is restricted to.

block.description: The data source `zentral_santa_enrollment` allows details of a Santa enrollment to be retrieved by its `ID`.

custom_message.description: Custom message displayed in the popover when a binary is blocked.

custom_url.description: Custom URL the user can visit for more information when blocked.

description.description: Description of the rule. Only displayed in the Zentral GUI.

excluded_primary_users.description: The excluded primary users used to scope the rule.

excluded_serial_numbers.description: The excluded serial numbers used to scope the rule.

excluded_tag_ids.description: The `ID`s of the excluded tags used to scope the rule.

primary_users.description: The primary users used to scope the rule.

serial_numbers.description: The serial numbers used to scope the rule.

tag_ids.description: The `ID`s of the tags used to scope the rule.

target_identifier.description: Target identifier: binary, certificate sha256, signing ID or team ID.

target_type.description: Target type. Valid values are `BINARY`, `CDHASH`, `CERTIFICATE`, `SIGNINGID` and `TEAMID`.
